plates.title: Desktop display on an oak island
plates.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: one photorealistic EMPTY brand application plate, member of a coherent warm-oak retail template family.
Input image1 and2: visual style/material/lighting references ONLY. Do not copy their phone, auditorium or actual composition; create the distinct subject below. No contact sheets.
Primary scene: A single slim silver aluminium 27-inch desktop monitor on its elegant metal pedestal, standing on a long thick light-oak communal retail table. Three-quarter front view at seated eye height, monitor on right-center, pale limestone floor, softly focused off-white concrete wall and tall oak slats in the distant left background. Thin black bezel, entire active screen a uniform neutral very pale warm gray, with subtle realistic glass reflection only. One low-profile white keyboard partially visible in front and one small matching mouse; no laptop, phone, auditorium, posters or wall-mounted screen. Strong clear screen hero, about half image width, airy left negative space.
Look and feel: premium minimal technology retail architecture, warm honey/light natural oak with authentic unpainted grain, pale warm limestone/concrete, ivory and finely brushed silver aluminium. Same calm, quiet, architectural visual family as references, controlled late-afternoon warm-neutral daylight, soft but directional natural shadows, warm highlights, accurate physical scale and clean craftsmanship. Photorealistic architectural/product photography with realistic texture, restrained depth of field; the application surface is in clear focus. No excessive bokeh or orange color cast.
Composition: one new landscape shot in 16:9. Frame the intended application surface clearly and preserve generous intentional negative space. Completely different composition/subject from the referenced original4 shots.
Placeholder requirements: screen, optional keyboard-free foreground. All intended application faces must be genuinely empty and unbranded, clean neutral surfaces with natural lighting. No mock artwork, instructions, placeholder labels, crop marks, watermarks, logos, readable or fake text, UI, Apple logo or source reference's green graphics.
Output: a single high-detail image. Aim 3840x2160 landscape if available; preserve 16:9. No borders, no text, no collage.

refinement.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Input image1 is the edit target, an almost finished blank photographic product template.
Make exactly one tiny local change: remove the faint gray logo/symbol printed near the center of the white mouse at lower right. The entire upper shell of the mouse should be plain unmarked warm-white material with the same natural shading and reflection. Preserve the mouse shape, edge, placement and shadow.
Everything else is invariant: monitor and clean blank screen, silver stand, keyboard, wood grain, oak wall, stone, stools, camera, crop, exact layout, sunlight and cast shadows. Do not change any other surface or add details. Output one same-aspect landscape image; no logos, text, watermarks or new marks.
refinement.hint:
Generated images are saved to /Users/abhishekmankotia/.codex/generated_images/01a18991-4297-75e0-9931-edfcaa2d49c3 as /Users/abhishekmankotia/.codex/generated_images/01a18991-4297-75e0-9931-edfcaa2d49c3/exec-63348bb3-665c-49ab-b3c7-e591e87602ba.png by default.
If you need to use a generated image at another path, copy it and leave the original in place unless the user explicitly asks you to delete it.
The generated image is already displayed to the user. There is no need to render it in the final response as a Markdown image or file link.
